actions.description: Document the recoverable conflict returned when the aggregate root exists but creation of at least one locked child fails.

409.description: The payment-request aggregate was created, but at least one locked child could not be created. Existing resources are retained. Inspect the aggregate identified by the response headers before taking recovery action; do not blindly recreate the request.

Location.description: Relative URL of the retained payment-request aggregate.

X-FlowPay-Payment-Request-Id.description: Identifier of the retained payment-request aggregate.

message.description: Error description including the retained aggregate identifier and the upstream failure context.
